import json,re,collections
for name in ("pneumo","cancero"):
    d=json.load(open(f"results_{name}.json")); t=d["passes"][0]["item_texts"]
    k=sorted(t, key=lambda n: len(t[n]))[len(t)//2]; lines=t[k].splitlines()
    idx=[i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if re.fullmatch(r"\s*\d+\s*",l)][:4]
    print("==",name,"item",k)
    for i in idx: print("   ...", " | ".join(l[:50] for l in lines[max(0,i-1):i+2]))
    # lignes répétées dans l'item (en-têtes/pieds courants)
    c=collections.Counter(l.strip() for l in lines if l.strip()); rep=[(l,n) for l,n in c.most_common(6) if n>=3]
    print("   lignes répétées:", rep[:5])
